interpretation.chart: margin = 1/max(1,max_abs(decoded)); an output-amplitude statistic, not pole or conditioning evidence
interpretation.conditioning: no perturbation probe was executed; neither absolute denominator size nor amplitude establishes a pole
interpretation.cutoffs: unresolved leading spectral gaps are counted per condition, not distinct eigenvalue claims across repeated conditions
interpretation.fixed_lift: representation-specific logarithmic scales with global exponent -12910; never exponentiated
interpretation.validity: fixed-lift summaries include all rows; decoded amplitude is also separately summarized only on valid rows
interpretation.zeros: log magnitudes may be -infinity for exact zeros; log ratios may be +/-infinity; zero/zero ratios are undefined
